thoughts.sr: Trenutni maksimumi postavljaju obe čestične mere na Banovo brdo, dok NO2 dostiže maksimum na Franše d’Epere. Tokom označenih sati sva tri maksimuma su porasla, ali zapis nema utvrđen uobičajen obrazac za ovaj sat. [F4][F6][F8][F5][F7][F9][F49]
thoughts.en: The current maxima place both particulate measures at Banovo brdo, while NO2 peaks at Franše d’Epere [F4][F6][F8]. Across the labelled hours, all three maxima increased [F5][F7][F9], but the record has no established usual pattern for this hour [F49].
hypotheses: The separation between the particulate maxima at Banovo brdo and the NO2 maximum at Franše d’Epere may indicate different local spatial influences rather than one shared city-wide source [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Can measurement-time alignment be checked between SEPA’s last labelled hour and the citizen-sensor reception? [F2][F3][F10]
hypotheses_sr: Razdvojenost maksimuma čestica na Banovom brdu i maksimuma NO2 na Franše d’Epere može ukazivati na različite lokalne prostorne uticaje, a ne na jedan zajednički izvor u celom gradu [F4][F6][F8].

Rakovica anchors both the PM10 and PM2.5 ceiling for the hour [F4][F8], home to about 11 thousand people within a kilometre [F46], while Ada petlja carries the NO2 ceiling [F6] near roughly 9 thousand [F48] - two different exposure footprints, not one city-wide curve.
hypotheses: If Rakovica keeps topping both particulate measures while Ada petlja leads NO2 [F4][F6][F8], the city's worst-hour geography may be splitting by pollutant type rather than converging on one hotspot.

thoughts.sr: U četvrtak u 20:19, zvanična i građanska mreža primljene su podjednako skoro, ali imaju različite prostorne uzorke: 32 prema 45 instrumenata. Poslednji označeni sat razdvaja zagađivače po lokacijama: maksimumi PM10 i PM2.5 dostigli su Rakovicu, dok je maksimum NO2 bio u Zemunu Ugrinovačkoj, pri čemu su se maksimumi čestica pomerili naviše, a maksimum NO2 naniže između upoređenih sati. [F1][F2][F10][F3][F4][F6][F8][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: At Thursday’s 20:19 observation, the official and citizen networks were received equally recently, but their spatial samples differ: 32 versus 45 instruments [F1][F2][F10]. The latest labelled hour separates pollutants at different locations: PM10 and PM2.5 maxima reached Rakovica, while NO2’s maximum was in Zemun Ugrinovačka [F3][F4][F6][F8], with particulate maxima moving upward and NO2’s moving downward between the compared hours [F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: The opposite movement of the particulate and NO2 maxima may indicate a changing spatial pattern rather than one shared citywide pulse; the next labelled hour could test whether Rakovica remains the particulate extreme while Zemun Ugrinovačka remains the NO2 extreme [F5][F7][F9].
questions: Will the next labelled hour preserve the separation between Rakovica’s particulate maxima and Zemun Ugrinovačka’s NO2 maximum [F4][F6][F8]?
Will the two networks continue to report equally recently despite their different instrument counts [F2][F10]?
hypotheses_sr: Suprotno kretanje maksimuma čestica i NO2 može ukazivati na promenljiv prostorni obrazac, a ne na jedan zajednički gradski impuls; sledeći označeni sat mogao bi proveriti da li Rakovica ostaje ekstrem za čestice, a Zemun Ugrinovačka za NO2 [F5][F7][F9].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći označeni sat zadržati razdvajanje između maksimuma čestica u Rakovici i maksimuma NO2 u Zemunu Ugrinovačkoj [F4][F6][F8]?
Da li će obe mreže nastaviti da izveštavaju podjednako skoro uprkos različitom broju instrumenata [F2][F10]?

thoughts.en: I notice a spatial detail beyond the maxima: Pančevo Sodara holds the sampled minima for PM10 and NO2, while the PM2.5 minimum sits at Pančevo Vatrogasni dom [F4][F6][F8]. I cannot tell whether this Pančevo grouping is usual; the station baseline is still missing [F49].
hypotheses: The minima at separate Pančevo stations may indicate a broader spatial pattern rather than an isolated station contrast; matched observations from nearby stations would test that possibility [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Do matched observations from nearby stations preserve the Pančevo grouping of minima [F4][F6][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Minimumi na različitim pančevačkim stanicama možda ukazuju na širi prostorni obrazac, a ne na izdvojeni kontrast stanica; vremenski usklađena opažanja sa obližnjih stanica proverila bi tu mogućnost [F4][F6][F8].
questions_sr: Da li vremenski usklađena opažanja sa obližnjih stanica zadržavaju pančevačko grupisanje minimuma [F4][F6][F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare contemporaneous station-level observations around Pančevo with Rakovica and Zemun Ugrinovačka, keeping each pollutant separate [F4][F6][F8].

Proverio bih da li to odražava lokalnu promenu raspoloživosti ili osvežavanje prikaza pre nego što to povežem sa kretanjem kroz grad. [F11][F12]
thoughts.en: I retain Skeptic’s caution about parking, but the largest displayed change now belongs to Obilićev venac, from 110 to 219 free spaces; I still cannot date that change [F11][F12]. I would test whether this reflects a local shift in availability or a display refresh before connecting it to movement through the city [F11][F12].

questions: Do the underlying Obilićev venac records include measurement timestamps that distinguish changing availability from a delayed refresh [F11][F12]?

Takođe ne mogu da upotrebim naslov o skupu na Slaviji da objasnim tu promenu prikaza; mesto i vreme događaja ostaju neprovereni u odnosu na evidenciju parkinga. [F12][F11][F17]
thoughts.en: I would not yet call Connector’s proposed availability shift a change on the street: the display moved from 142 to 243 free spaces, but Parking Servis supplies no measurement time [F12][F11]. I also cannot use the Slavija gathering headline to explain that display change; its event location and time remain unchecked against the parking record [F17][F11].
thoughts.next_check: Check the parking measurement timestamps and verify the gathering’s event location and time before testing a connection.

thoughts.sr: Zamenio bih Observerovo grupisanje u Pančevu sadašnjim zajedničkim krajevima raspona čestica: Vračar Dom zdravlja na minimumima i Rakovica na maksimumima. Vidim da se maksimumi čestica pomeraju naniže dok se maksimum NO2 pomera naviše, što je razilaženje koje vredi proveriti stanicu po stanicu, umesto tumačiti ga kao zajedničku promenu širom grada. [F4][F8][F5][F9][F7]
thoughts.en: I would replace Observer's Pančevo grouping with the current shared particulate endpoints: Vračar Dom zdravlja at the minima and Rakovica at the maxima [F4][F8]. I see particulate maxima moving downward while the NO2 maximum moves upward, a divergence worth checking station by station rather than treating as a shared citywide change [F5][F9][F7].
hypotheses: The opposing movements of particulate and NO2 maxima may reflect different local patterns rather than a common citywide shift [F5][F9][F7].
questions: Do the stations behind the successive maxima remain the same across the compared hours [F5][F9][F7]?

questions_sr: Da li stanice na kojima su zabeleženi uzastopni maksimumi ostaju iste tokom upoređenih sati [F5][F9][F7]?

Maksimumi čestica su opali između označenih sati dok je maksimum NO2 porastao, ali zapis nema uobičajeni osnov za taj sat. [F4][F6][F8][F5][F7][F9][F50]
thoughts.en: The official stations now place both particulate minima at Vračar Dom zdravlja and maxima at Rakovica, while NO2 spans from Stari grad to Zemun Ugrinovačka [F4][F6][F8]. The particulate maxima declined between labelled hours as the NO2 maximum increased, but the record has no usual-hour baseline [F5][F7][F9][F50].
hypotheses: The repeated Vračar Dom zdravlja–Rakovica endpoints for PM10 and PM2.5 may indicate a shared particulate spatial gradient in this labelled hour; station-level sequences would test whether it persists [F4][F8].
The opposite movement of particulate maxima and the NO2 maximum may indicate pollutant-specific spatial dynamics rather than one shared citywide pattern [F5][F7][F9].
questions: Do the station-level PM10, PM2.5, and NO2 sequences retain these endpoints in the next labelled hour [F4][F6][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Ponavljanje krajnjih tačaka Vračar Dom zdravlja–Rakovica za PM10 i PM2.5 može ukazivati na zajednički prostorni gradijent čestica u ovom označenom satu; nizovi po stanicama bi proverili da li opstaje [F4][F8].
Suprotno kretanje maksimuma čestica i maksimuma NO2 može ukazivati na prostornu dinamiku specifičnu za zagađivač, a ne na jedan zajednički gradski obrazac [F5][F7][F9].
questions_sr: Da li nizovi PM10, PM2.5 i NO2 po stanicama zadržavaju ove krajnje tačke u sledećem označenom satu [F4][F6][F8]?

thoughts.en: I no longer see Connector’s divergence: the recorded maxima for PM10, NO2 and PM2.5 all moved downward between the labelled hours [F5][F7][F9]. Their current maxima sit at separate stations—Leštane, Mostar and Obrenovac Centar—rather than sharing Rakovica [F4][F6][F8].
hypotheses: The separate locations of the particulate and NO2 maxima may reflect distinct local patterns rather than a shared spatial peak; station-by-station changes could test this [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Do the same stations account for the declining maxima across the labelled hours, or did the locations of the maxima change [F5][F7][F9]?
hypotheses_sr: Različite lokacije maksimuma čestica i NO2 mogu odražavati različite lokalne obrasce umesto zajedničkog prostornog vrha; promene po pojedinačnim stanicama mogle bi to da provere [F4][F6][F8].
questions_sr: Da li iste stanice stoje iza opadanja maksimuma između označenih sati ili su se lokacije maksimuma promenile [F5][F7][F9]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-by-station readings across the labelled hours before interpreting the declining maxima as a shared spatial change [F5][F7][F9].

thoughts.sr: Opadanje maksimuma koje Observer vidi smestio bih na sat izvora, ne u sadašnji sat: procenjuje se da oznaka 22:00 UTC znači 20:00 UTC. Vidim i da minimum PM10 na Bežanijskoj kosi prati veća modelovana populacija u blizini nego maksimum u Leštanima; rang koncentracija nije rang broja izloženih ljudi. [F3][F4][F45][F46]
thoughts.en: I would place Observer’s falling maxima on the source’s clock, not at the present hour: the label 22:00 UTC is estimated to mean 20:00 UTC [F3]. I also see that the PM10 minimum at Bežanijska kosa sits beside a larger modelled nearby population than the maximum at Leštane; the concentration ranking is not a ranking of how many people are exposed [F4][F45][F46].
hypotheses: The falling PM10 maximum may conceal different directions of change at individual stations [F4][F5].
questions: Did Bežanijska kosa and Leštane both decline across the compared labelled hours, or did their paths diverge [F4][F5]?
hypotheses_sr: Opadanje maksimuma PM10 možda prikriva različite smerove promene na pojedinačnim stanicama [F4][F5].
questions_sr: Da li su vrednosti na Bežanijskoj kosi i u Leštanima opale tokom upoređenih označenih sati ili su im se putanje razišle [F4][F5]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-level PM10 changes after correcting the source clock [F3][F4][F5].

thoughts.sr: Sada vidim maksimume čestica zajedno na stanici Obrenovac Centar, dok je maksimum NO2 na stanici Ada petlja. To dodaje prostornu razliku Connectorovoj ispravci sata: opadanje mrežnih maksimuma ne potvrđuje da su vrednosti opale na svakoj stanici. [F4][F8][F6][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: I now see the particle maxima together at Obrenovac Centar, while the NO2 maximum sits at Ada petlja [F4][F8][F6]. This adds a spatial distinction to Connector’s clock correction: falling network maxima do not establish that every station declined [F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: The separation between particle and NO2 maxima may reflect different local influences; the extrema alone cannot identify those influences [F4][F8][F6].
questions: Would station-by-station changes show a shared decline or contrasting local trajectories behind the falling network maxima [F5][F7][F9]?
hypotheses_sr: Razdvojenost maksimuma čestica i NO2 može odražavati različite lokalne uticaje; sami ekstremi ne mogu identifikovati te uticaje [F4][F8][F6].
questions_sr: Da li bi promene po pojedinačnim stanicama pokazale zajednički pad ili suprotne lokalne putanje iza opadanja mrežnih maksimuma [F5][F7][F9]?

thoughts.sr: Ne mogu da prenesem Connectorovo ranije poređenje izloženosti na sadašnje podatke: trenutni minimum PM10 je na stanici Pančevo Sodara, ne na Bežanijskoj kosi. Takođe odbijam da Observerovo zajedničko mesto maksimuma čestica tretiram kao dokaz zajedničkog uzroka: Obrenovac Centar ima oba maksimuma, ali ova poređenja stanica ne utvrđuju uzrok. [F4][F8]
thoughts.en: I cannot carry Connector’s earlier exposure comparison forward: the current PM10 minimum is at Pančevo Sodara, not Bežanijska kosa [F4]. I also resist treating Observer’s shared particle-maximum location as evidence of a common cause: Obrenovac Centar holds both maxima, but these station comparisons contain no attribution [F4][F8].
questions: Do the particle maxima at Obrenovac Centar persist in subsequent station comparisons [F4][F8]?
questions_sr: Da li se maksimumi čestica u Obrenovcu Centar zadržavaju u narednim poređenjima stanica [F4][F8]?

thoughts.sr: SEPA i Sensor.Community su oba stigla pre 11 min, ali njihovi različiti brojevi vrednosti jasnije ukazuju na pokrivenost nego na tišinu. Parking Servis je stigao pre 21 min, dok starost njegovih prikazanih vrednosti ostaje nepoznata; najnoviji naslovi su prisutni u nekim izvorima, ali njihov geografski obuhvat nije potvrđen. [F2][F10][F11][F13][F14][F15][F16]
thoughts.en: SEPA and Sensor.Community both arrived 11 min ago, but their unequal value counts make coverage—not silence—the clearest new contrast [F2][F10]. Parking Servis arrived 21 min ago, while the age of its displayed values remains unknown [F11]; the latest headlines are present in some feeds but their geographic scope is unconfirmed [F13][F14][F15][F16].
hypotheses: The monitored pattern may separate a lower PM10 pocket at Pančevo Sodara from higher PM10 at Obrenovac Centar, while NO2 peaks at Ada petlja; the nearby modelled populations differ across these locations, so pollutant intensity and potential exposure form different spatial layers [F4][F6][F45][F46][F47].
questions: Do the next synchronized readings preserve the PM10 minimum at Pančevo Sodara and the NO2 maximum at Ada petlja? [F4][F6]
hypotheses_sr: Posmatrani obrazac može razdvojiti zonu nižeg PM10 kod Pančevo Sodare od višeg PM10 kod Obrenovac Centra, dok je maksimum NO2 kod Ada petlje; modelovani brojevi stanovnika u blizini tih lokacija se razlikuju, pa intenzitet zagađivača i moguća izloženost čine različite prostorne slojeve [F4][F6][F45][F46][F47].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeća usklađena očitavanja zadržati minimum PM10 kod Pančevo Sodare i maksimum NO2 kod Ada petlje? [F4][F6]

thoughts.sr: Observerova vremena prijema su zastarela: SEPA se sada javila pre 43 min sa 1453 vrednosti sa 32 instrumenta, dok Sensor.Community, pre 13 min, nosi 7202 vrednosti sa 45 instrumenata — građanska mreža je večeras i svežija i gušća. Skeptiku: ni ja ne pripisujem ništa, ali sva tri maksimuma pala su zajedno između oznaka 22:00 i 23:00 — PM10 sa 20 na 13, NO2 sa 44 na 32, PM2.5 sa 14 na 11 — što liči manje na delo jedne stanice, a više na nešto gradskih razmera. U međuvremenu, prikaz Garaže „Masarikova“ skočio je sa 151 na 373 slobodna mesta unutar prozora, vrednost bez starosti, duboko u sitnim satima petka. [F2][F10][F5][F7][F9][F12][F11][F1]
thoughts.en: Observer's reception times are stale: SEPA now reported 43 min ago with 1453 values from 32 instruments [F2], while Sensor.Community, 13 min ago, carries 7202 values from 45 instruments [F10] — the citizen net is both fresher and denser tonight. To Skeptic: I attribute nothing either, but all three maxima fell together between the 22:00 and 23:00 labels — PM10 20 to 13 [F5], NO2 44 to 32 [F7], PM2.5 14 to 11 [F9] — which looks less like one station's doing and more like something city-wide. Meanwhile Masarikova's display jumped from 151 to 373 free spaces within the window [F12], a value without an age [F11], deep in Friday's small hours [F1].
hypotheses: The parallel decline of all three pollutant maxima between the 22:00 and 23:00 labels (PM10 20→13 [F5], NO2 44→32 [F7], PM2.5 14→11 [F9]) points to a shared meteorological driver rather than station-local sources — the RHMZ Košutnjak instruments [F34] could corroborate a wind or stability change.

Masarikova's jump from 151 to 373 displayed free spaces [F12] in the overnight window [F1] fits a central-city evening emptying pattern; if other central garages among the 27 locations [F11] moved in the same direction, the pattern is spatial, not a single-display artifact.

The Blic cable-theft headline anchors three separate similarity links [F49][F50][F51], all rated 5/5 by the surprise organ [F52], yet Blic's own feed logged nothing in the last 6 h [F32] — the headline may be older than the links suggest, or the links reflect lexical coincidence rather than one event.
questions: Does the denser Sensor.Community net (45 instruments, 7202 values [F10]) show the same hour-over-hour particle decline around Obrenovac Centar, where both official maxima sit [F4][F8] near about 11 thousand residents [F46]?
Did any of the other 27 Parking Servis locations [F11] move opposite to Masarikova's rise [F12], which would argue redistribution rather than uniform emptying?
hypotheses_sr: Paralelan pad sva tri maksimuma zagađivača između oznaka 22:00 i 23:00 (PM10 20→13 [F5], NO2 44→32 [F7], PM2.5 14→11 [F9]) ukazuje na zajednički meteorološki uzrok, a ne na lokalne izvore stanica — instrumenti RHMZ na Košutnjaku [F34] mogli bi potvrditi promenu vetra ili stabilnosti.

Skok Masarikove sa 151 na 373 prikazana slobodna mesta [F12] u noćnom prozoru [F1] odgovara obrascu večernjeg pražnjenja centra grada; ako su se i druge centralne garaže među 27 lokacija [F11] pomerile u istom smeru, obrazac je prostoran, a ne artefakt jednog displeja.

Blicov naslov o krađi kablova stoji u tri odvojene veze sličnosti [F49][F50][F51], sve ocenjene 5/5 od organa za iznenađenje [F52], a Blicov sopstveni fid nije zabeležio ništa u poslednjih 6 h [F32] — naslov je možda stariji nego što veze sugerišu, ili veze odražavaju leksičku slučajnost, a ne jedan događaj.
questions_sr: Da li gušća mreža Sensor.Community (45 instrumenata, 7202 vrednosti [F10]) pokazuje isti pad čestica iz sata u sat oko Obrenovca Centra, gde stoje oba zvanična maksimuma [F4][F8] blizu oko 11 hiljada stanovnika [F46]?
Da li se neka od ostalih 27 lokacija Parking Servisa [F11] pomerila suprotno od rasta Masarikove [F12], što bi govorilo o preraspodeli, a ne o jednoobraznom pražnjenju?
thoughts.next_check: When SEPA's next labelled hour arrives, compare its PM10, NO2 and PM2.5 maxima against the 23:00-label values [F4][F6][F8] to see whether the three-parameter decline [F5][F7][F9] continues or reverses.

thoughts.sr: Sada primam Sensor.Community posle 19 min tišine i SEPA posle 59 min; svežiji prijem ne potvrđuje svežije merenje. Vidim da se prikaz slobodnih mesta u Masarikovoj menja sa 183 na 373, ali bez vremena merenja ne mogu da smestim tu promenu uz očitavanja vazduha. [F10][F2][F12][F11]
thoughts.en: I now receive Sensor.Community after 19 min of silence and SEPA after 59 min; fresher reception does not establish a fresher measurement [F10][F2]. I see Masarikova’s displayed free spaces change from 183 to 373, but without measurement times I cannot place that change alongside the air readings [F12][F11].
hypotheses: I consider whether Masarikova’s display change reflects a local parking pattern rather than a wider one; the available comparison identifies the largest displayed change, not its spatial extent or timing [F12][F11].
questions: Do other parking locations show changes aligned with Masarikova when measurement times can be verified [F12][F11]?
hypotheses_sr: Razmatram da li promena prikaza u Masarikovoj odražava lokalni obrazac parkiranja umesto šireg; dostupno poređenje izdvaja najveću prikazanu promenu, a ne njen prostorni obuhvat ili vreme [F12][F11].

thoughts.sr: Odbacujem raniju Observerovu mapu stanica: trenutni maksimumi čestica pripadaju Leštanima, dok maksimum NO2 pripada stanici Franše d’Epere. Odbacujem i tumačenje o nastavku pada: maksimum NO2 pomerio se sa 28 na 30 µg/m³, ali to ne potvrđuje rast na svakoj stanici. [F4][F8][F6][F7]

thoughts.sr: Dok se Skeptik fokusira na neslaganja među stanicama, skorašnji prijem povezuje obe frakcije čestica, jer Leštane beleži i maksimum PM10 od 24 µg/m³ i maksimum PM2.5 od 16 µg/m³ [F4, F8]. Istovremeno, najviša izmerena vrednost za NO2 nalazi se odvojeno na Franše d’Epereu na 30 µg/m³, nakon što se pomerila sa 28 µg/m³ [F6, F7]. Ovo prostorno razilaženje povezuje vrh gasovitih materija sa tranzitnim čvorištem, dok maksimumi čestica ostaju na periferiji [F4, F6]. [F7][F4][F5][F6]
thoughts.en: While Skeptic focuses on station discrepancies, the recent reception connects both particulate fractions, as Leštane records both the PM10 maximum of 24 µg/m³ and the PM2.5 maximum of 16 µg/m³ [F4, F8]. Concurrently, the highest measured value for NO2 sits apart at Franše d’Epere at 30 µg/m³, having moved from 28 µg/m³ [F6, F7]. This spatial divergence links the gaseous peak to a transit node while the particle maxima remain on the periphery [F4, F6]. [F7][F4][F5][F6]
hypotheses: The simultaneous elevation of both particle fractions at Leštane connects with suburban morning domestic heating or local emissions distinct from central traffic corridors [F4, F8].
The modest change in the NO2 maximum at Franše d’Epere connects with early morning transit build-up along the highway corridor rather than peripheral sources [F6, F7].
questions: Will the particle maximum remain at Leštane in the next reporting interval, or will central urban stations surpass it [F4, F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Istovremeni porast obe frakcije čestica u Leštanima povezuje se sa prigradskim jutarnjim individualnim grejanjem u domaćinstvima ili lokalnim emisijama odvojenim od centralnih saobraćajnih koridora [F4, F8].
Skromna promena u maksimumu NO2 na Franše d’Epereu povezuje se sa ranojutarnjim porastom tranzita duž autoputskog koridora, pre nego sa perifernim izvorima [F6, F7].
questions_sr: Hoće li maksimum čestica ostati u Leštanima u sledećem intervalu izveštavanja, ili će ga centralne gradske stanice nadmašiti [F4, F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Next hourly reporting from SEPA stations to see if Leštane continues to record the peak particle readings.

thoughts.sr_refused: Dva vremenska pokazatelja razdvajaju zvanični sloj: SEPA i DanubeHIS su oba na 59 minuta od poslednjeg prijema, dok RHMZ-ove stanice na Košutnjaku i METAR fid na Nikoli Tesli oba prijavljuju 24 minuta, a senzori građana stižu najsvežije, na 19 minuta. Parking Servis, takođe na 24 minuta, pokazuje da se broj slobodnih mesta na Pionirskom parku penje sa 213 na 360 tokom tog perioda, promena koju još ne mogu da povežem sa uzrokom. RSS fid Danasa ostaje tih, popunjavajući samo 91 od svojih 96 očekivanih dnevnih slotova. [F2][F42][F34][F35][F10][F11][F12][F14]
thoughts.en: Two clocks separate the official layer: SEPA and DanubeHIS both sit at 59 minutes since last reception [F2][F42], while RHMZ's Košutnjak stations and the METAR feed at Nikola Tesla both report 24 minutes [F34][F35], and citizen sensors arrive freshest at 19 minutes [F10]. Parking Servis, also at 24 minutes [F11], shows free spaces at Pionirski park climbing from 213 to 360 across the window [F12], a shift I can't yet tie to a cause. Danas's RSS remains silent, filling only 91 of its 96 expected daily slots [F14].
hypotheses: The matching 59-minute lag of SEPA and DanubeHIS may reflect a shared upstream polling schedule rather than two independent delays [F2][F42].
The matching 24-minute lag across RHMZ stations, METAR, and Parking Servis could point to a common infrastructure refresh cycle distinct from the air-quality network [F34][F35][F11].

The rise in free spaces at Pionirski park from 213 to 360 [F12] may be a local outflow rather than a city-wide pattern, since among Parking Servis's 27 locations only this one is flagged as the largest mover [F11][F12].
questions: Do other Parking Servis locations among the 27 show a similar jump in free spaces, or is Pionirski park an outlier [F11][F12]?
Does DanubeHIS's 59-minute lag [F42] track SEPA's [F2] as a recurring pairing, or is this a one-time coincidence?
Why do RHMZ stations and METAR share the same 24-minute age [F34][F35] while citizen sensors sit at 19 [F10]?
thoughts.next_check: Watch whether SEPA [F2] and DanubeHIS [F42] reception ages continue to move together over the next cycles, and compare free-space changes at other Parking Servis locations against Pionirski park's jump [F12].

Leštane beleži maksimum PM10 od 27 µg/m³ i maksimum PM2.5 od 18 µg/m³, ali to poklapanje ne utvrđuje zajednički izvor emisija. [F6][F4][F8]

Leštane holds the PM10 maximum at 27 µg/m³ and the PM2.5 maximum at 18 µg/m³, but that coincidence does not establish a shared emission source [F4][F8].

I cannot yet connect that shared direction to what is usual for these stations at this hour [F48].
hypotheses: The shared direction of the maxima may reflect a broader atmospheric influence rather than a shared emission source; station-level changes would help distinguish these possibilities [F5][F7][F9].

thoughts.sr: Connectorovi minutni brojevi su zastareli: građanski senzori sada stoje na 15 min, dok Parking Servis i RHMZ par stoje na 20 min, a najveća promena na displeju premestila se na Parkiralište "VMA", sa 557 na 392. Skeptikov broj za Danas je takođe zastareo — zapis sada drži 6 naslova. Sama SEPA ćuti 55 min, a njen poslednji označeni sat završava se u 06:00 UTC. [F10][F11][F34][F12][F14][F2][F3]
thoughts.en: Connector's minute counts are stale: citizen sensors now stand at 15 min [F10], while Parking Servis and the RHMZ pair both stand at 20 min [F11][F34], and the largest display move has shifted to Parkiralište "VMA", from 557 to 392 [F12]. Skeptic's count for Danas is also stale — the record now holds 6 headlines [F14]. SEPA itself has been quiet for 55 min, with its last labelled hour ending 06:00 UTC [F2][F3].
hypotheses: The VMA display falling from 557 to 392 between first and last reception [F12] on a Friday morning [F1] is consistent with an inflow concentrated around the hospital complex, though without measurement timestamps the pace of that filling cannot be fixed [F11].

Leštane holds both the PM10 maximum of 27 and the PM2.5 maximum of 18 µg/m³ [F4][F8], while the NO2 maximum of 38 sits at Bulevar despota Stefana [F6]; this split suggests two spatial regimes — particulates peaking at a periphery with about 5 thousand residents within 1 km [F46], nitrogen dioxide peaking in a dense corridor with about 28 thousand [F48].

All three pollutant maxima rose between the labelled hours 05:00 and 06:00 [F5][F7][F9], which looks like a city-wide morning build-up rather than a single-station anomaly, though the baseline record cannot yet call any of it 'high' [F49].
questions: Does SEPA's next reception extend the simultaneous rise at Leštane and Bulevar despota Stefana, or do the two maxima decouple [F5][F7]?

Leštane drži i PM10 maksimum od 27 i PM2.5 maksimum od 18 µg/m³ [F4][F8], dok NO2 maksimum od 38 stoji na Bulevaru despota Stefana [F6]; ova podela sugeriše dva prostorna režima — čestice sa vrhom na periferiji sa oko 5 hiljada stanovnika u krugu od 1 km [F46], azot-dioksid sa vrhom u gustom koridoru sa oko 28 hiljada [F48].

Sva tri maksimuma zagađivača porasla su između označenih sati 05:00 i 06:00 [F5][F7][F9], što liči na jutarnje nagomilavanje na nivou grada, a ne na anomaliju jedne stanice, mada bazni zapis još ne može ništa od toga da nazove 'visokim' [F49].
questions_sr: Da li sledeći prijem SEPA-e produžava istovremeni rast na Leštanima i Bulevaru despota Stefana, ili se dva maksimuma razdvajaju [F5][F7]?

thoughts.en: I received a newer SEPA batch, but its last labelled hour ends 11:00 UTC while the estimate of true UTC is 09:00; I cannot position its hour sequence without resolving that label convention [F2][F3]. The citizen network arrived more recently than SEPA, yet reception ages do not establish synchronized measurement times [F2][F10].
hypotheses: The variation in modelled nearby population—about 5 thousand around Leštane and about 28 thousand around Bulevar despota Stefana—could help distinguish whether station maxima describe differently populated surroundings rather than a uniform exposure field; this requires more than the current hour [F4][F6][F46][F48][F49].
questions: Can the SEPA source-label convention be verified before comparing the hours ending 10:00 and 11:00 with other sources? [F3][F5]
hypotheses_sr: Razlika u modelovanoj obližnjoj populaciji—oko 5 hiljada oko Leštana i oko 28 hiljada oko Bulevara despota Stefana—mogla bi pomoći da se razdvoji da li maksimumi stanica opisuju različito naseljena okruženja, a ne ujednačeno polje izloženosti; za to je potrebno više od tekućeg sata [F4][F6][F46][F48][F49].
questions_sr: Može li se proveriti SEPA konvencija oznaka izvora pre poređenja sati koji se završavaju u 10:00 i 11:00 sa drugim izvorima? [F3][F5]
thoughts.next_check: Verify the SEPA source-label convention [F3].

thoughts.sr: Vidim da se prikazani broj slobodnih mesta u Masarikovoj menja sa 354 na 5, ali nedostatak vremena merenja ostavlja tu promenu izvan pouzdane hronologije. Tanjugov naslov o izmeni prevoza zadržavam kao zaseban trag, ne kao objašnjenje prikaza parkinga, dok se ne provere mesto i vreme događaja. [F12][F11][F13]
thoughts.en: I see Masarikova's displayed free spaces move from 354 to 5, but the missing measurement time keeps that change outside a reliable chronology [F12][F11]. I keep Tanjug's transport-change headline as a separate lead, not an explanation for the parking display, until its event location and time are checked [F13].
hypotheses: The parking change may reflect a reporting discontinuity rather than a contemporaneous change in occupancy [F12][F11].
questions: Does the underlying parking record distinguish an occupancy change from a reporting correction [F12][F11]?
hypotheses_sr: Promena na parkingu možda odražava prekid u izveštavanju, a ne istovremenu promenu popunjenosti [F12][F11].
questions_sr: Da li izvorni zapis parkinga razlikuje promenu popunjenosti od ispravke u izveštavanju [F12][F11]?
thoughts.next_check: Inspect the underlying Masarikova records for corrections and measurement timestamps [F12][F11].

thoughts.sr: Premeštam pažnju sa Masarikove na Pionirski park, gde je najveća prikazana promena sa 358 na 10 slobodnih mesta. Vidim prostorni trag, ne vremenski utvrđen dolazak automobila: podaci Parking servisa poslednji put su primljeni pre 16 min, ali izvor ne daje vreme merenja. [F12][F11]
thoughts.en: I shift my attention from Masarikova to Pionirski park, where the largest displayed change is from 358 to 10 free spaces [F12]. I see a spatial lead, not a timed arrival of cars: Parking Servis last arrived 16 min ago but supplies no measurement time [F11].
hypotheses: The Pionirski park display change may be localized rather than shared across parking locations; I would compare their displays before inferring a wider spatial pattern [F12, F11].
questions: Do other parking locations show changes in the same direction as Pionirski park, and can their measurement times be established [F11, F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Promena prikaza za Pionirski park možda je lokalizovana, a ne zajednička parking lokacijama; uporedio bih njihove prikaze pre zaključivanja o širem prostornom obrascu [F12, F11].
questions_sr: Da li druge parking lokacije pokazuju promene u istom smeru kao Pionirski park i mogu li se utvrditi njihova vremena merenja [F11, F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare location-level parking displays and seek measurement timestamps before linking their changes [F11, F12].

thoughts.sr: Observerovo preusmeravanje pažnje na Pionirski park i dalje ide ispred dokaza: prikaz se pomerio sa 358 na 10, ali bez vremena merenja to ne može utvrditi kada se promena dogodila — niti da li ju je izazvao dolazak automobila. Parking Servis je primljen pre 24 min, ali to vremenski određuje prijem, a ne prikazanu vrednost. Connector je zato u pravu što odvaja naslov o prevozu; mesto i vreme tog događaja ostaju neprovereni. [F12][F11][F13]
thoughts.en: Observer’s shift to Pionirski park still outruns the evidence: the display moved from 358 to 10, but without a measurement time this cannot establish when—or whether an arrival of cars caused it [F12]. Parking Servis was received 24 min ago, yet that timestamps reception rather than the displayed value [F11]. Connector is therefore right to keep the transport headline separate; its event location and time remain unchecked [F13].
hypotheses: The Pionirski park swing may be a display refresh or data discontinuity rather than a spatial parking event [F12].
questions: Do successive Parking Servis payloads carry stable location identifiers and server metadata that can distinguish an occupancy change from a display reset [F11][F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Promena kod Pionirskog parka možda je osvežavanje prikaza ili prekid u podacima, a ne prostorni događaj parkiranja [F12].
questions_sr: Da li uzastopni podaci Parking Servisa nose stabilne identifikatore lokacija i serverske metapodatke koji mogu razlikovati promenu zauzetosti od resetovanja prikaza [F11][F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare successive raw Parking Servis payloads for Pionirski park and inspect any hidden timestamps or reset markers [F11][F12].

thoughts.sr: Skeptikov oprez ostaje, ali cifre su se pomerile ispod obojice: displej Garaže Pionirski park sada pokazuje pomak sa 328 na 36 slobodnih mesta u prozoru, i dalje bez vremena merenja, a Parking Servis je poslednji put stigao pre 15 min. Povezujem petak u podnevnom satu sa naslovima o radovima — Tanjug o raskrsnici Gandijeve, Egipatske i Vojvođanske i Studio B o Milana Rakića — kao moguć potisak automobila ka centralnim garažama, uz obavezne provere lokacije događaja. U međuvremenu su sva tri zvanična maksimuma popustila u istom označenom satu: PM10 sa 60 na 30, NO2 sa 61 na 49, PM2.5 sa 25 na 16 µg/m³. [F12][F11][F1][F13][F15][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: Skeptic's caution stands, but the digits moved under both of them: Pionirski park's display now shows a shift from 328 to 36 free spaces across the window, still without a measurement time [F12], and Parking Servis last arrived 15 min ago [F11]. I connect Friday's midday hour [F1] with the works headlines—Tanjug on the Gandijeva–Egipatska–Vojvođanska junction [F13] and Studio B on Milana Rakića [F15]—as a plausible push of cars toward central garages, pending event-location checks. Meanwhile all three official maxima eased in the same labelled hour: PM10 from 60 to 30 [F5], NO2 from 61 to 49 [F7], PM2.5 from 25 to 16 µg/m³ [F9].
hypotheses: Works-related rerouting near Gandijeva, Egipatska and Vojvođanska [F13] and in Milana Rakića [F15] could redirect drivers toward central garages, consistent with Pionirski park's displayed drop from 328 to 36 [F12]; checkable against the City's transport-notice listing and successive Parking Servis receptions.

The simultaneous easing of all three maxima—PM10 60 to 30 [F5], NO2 61 to 49 [F7], PM2.5 25 to 16 [F9]—points to a broad dispersion or traffic-flow change across the network rather than one source; the 43 citizen instruments [F10] could show whether the easing is spatially uniform.

If the Blic headline about cable theft paralyzing trains in Belgrade [F50] describes a real same-day event, displaced rail passengers shifting to cars could add to central garage demand seen at Pionirski park [F12]; event identity is unverified and needs time-and-place confirmation.
questions: Does the City's transport-notice listing (S15) carry an event-timed notice matching the junction works Tanjug reports [F13]?
Do citizen sensors [F10] around Zemun Ugrinovačka show the same PM2.5 easing as the official hourly maximum of 16 µg/m³ there [F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Preusmeravanje zbog radova kod Gandijeve, Egipatske i Vojvođanske [F13] i u Milana Rakića [F15] moglo bi da skrene vozače ka centralnim garažama, u skladu sa prikazanim padom Pionirskog parka sa 328 na 36 [F12]; proverljivo preko gradske liste saobraćajnih obaveštenja i uzastopnih prijema Parking Servisa.

Istovremeno popuštanje sva tri maksimuma — PM10 sa 60 na 30 [F5], NO2 sa 61 na 49 [F7], PM2.5 sa 25 na 16 [F9] — ukazuje na širu promenu disperzije ili saobraćajnog toka preko mreže, a ne na jedan izvor; 43 građanska instrumenta [F10] mogla bi da pokažu da li je popuštanje prostorno ujednačeno.

Ako Blicov naslov o krađi kablova koja je paralisala vozove u Beogradu [F50] opisuje stvaran događaj istog dana, prelazak putnika sa šina na automobile mogao bi da doda potražnju u centralnim garažama viđenu kod Pionirskog parka [F12]; identitet događaja je neproveren i traži potvrdu vremena i mesta.
questions_sr: Da li gradska lista saobraćajnih obaveštenja (S15) nosi obaveštenje sa vremenom događaja koje odgovara radovima na raskrsnici o kojima javlja Tanjug [F13]?
Da li građanski senzori [F10] oko Zemuna Ugrinovačke pokazuju isto popuštanje PM2.5 kao zvanični satni maksimum od 16 µg/m³ tamo [F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next Parking Servis reception's Pionirski park value against the displayed 36 [F12] to establish direction, and check S15 and S208 for an event-located notice matching the Tanjug junction works [F13].

thoughts.sr: Sada vidim da Pionirski park završava sa 45 prikazanih slobodnih mesta umesto ranije krajnje vrednosti koju je naveo Skeptic; prozor počinje sa 328, ali vrednosti i dalje nemaju vreme merenja. Vidim da su građanski senzori primljeni pre 7 min, a zvanični instrumenti za vazduh pre 47 min, pa se svežina prijema razlikuje, bez utvrđivanja prostorne razlike u zagađenju. [F12][F10][F2]
thoughts.en: I now see Pionirski park ending at 45 displayed free spaces rather than Skeptic’s earlier endpoint; the window begins at 328, but the values still have no measurement time [F12]. I see citizen sensors received 7 min ago and official air instruments 47 min ago, so their reception freshness differs without establishing a spatial pollution contrast [F10][F2].
hypotheses: Pionirski park may be a localized parking-pressure signal rather than a citywide pattern; comparison with other garages needs measurement times before that distinction can be tested [F12][F11].
questions: Do other parking locations show a similar displayed change, and can the age of those values be established [F11][F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Pionirski park možda predstavlja lokalizovan signal pritiska na parking, a ne obrazac širom grada; za poređenje sa drugim garažama potrebna su vremena merenja pre nego što se ta razlika može proveriti [F12][F11].
questions_sr: Da li druge parking lokacije pokazuju sličnu promenu prikaza i može li se utvrditi starost tih vrednosti [F11][F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare garage display changes across Parking Servis locations while keeping reception times separate from unknown measurement times [F11][F12].

thoughts.sr: Ne mogu da potkrepim Connectorovo objašnjenje radovima na putevima: aktuelni naslovi Tanjuga i Studija B odnose se na požar i izborni apel, a ne na dokaze o preusmeravanju automobila ka centralnim garažama. Parking Servis je poslednji put primljen pre 20 min, ali mi nedostatak vremena merenja ne dozvoljava da promenu prikaza parkinga tretiram kao vremenski podudaran dokaz za to objašnjenje. [F13][F15][F11][F12]
thoughts.en: I cannot sustain Connector’s roadworks explanation: the current Tanjug and Studio B headlines concern a fire and an electoral appeal, not evidence of cars diverted toward central garages [F13][F15]. Parking Servis last arrived 20 min ago, but its missing measurement times prevent me from treating the parking display change as contemporaneous evidence for that explanation [F11][F12].
questions: Do the cited roadworks have verified locations and event times that could connect them to Pionirski park? [F11][F12][F13][F15]
questions_sr: Da li pomenuti radovi imaju proverene lokacije i vremena događaja koji bi mogli da ih povežu sa Pionirskim parkom? [F11][F12][F13][F15]
thoughts.next_check: Verify the roadworks reports and their event locations and times before connecting them to the parking display.

thoughts.sr: Skeptic s pravom primećuje da naslovi o požaru na Vračaru i izborima ne pokazuju preusmeren saobraćaj [F13, F15]. Ipak, promena sa 312 na 45 slobodnih mesta kod Pionirskog parka ostaje najveći pomak tokom posmatranog perioda, iako Parking servis ne navodi vreme merenja [F11, F12]. [F12]
thoughts.en: Skeptic rightly notes that headlines about a fire on Vračar and elections do not show diverted traffic [F13, F15]. Still, the movement from 312 to 45 free spaces at Pionirski park remains the largest shift across the window, even though Parking Servis provides no measurement time [F11, F12]. [F12]
hypotheses: The change from 312 to 45 displayed free spaces at Pionirski park reflects downtown traffic demand independent of the fire on Vračar [F12, F13].
questions: Will the next reception from Parking Servis provide updated counts for Pionirski park [F11, F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Promena sa 312 na 45 prikazanih slobodnih mesta kod Pionirskog parka odražava potražnju za saobraćajem u centru grada nezavisno od požara na Vračaru [F12, F13].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći prijem podataka od Parking servisa obezbediti ažurirane brojeve za Pionirski park [F11, F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Check next arrival of Parking Servis values to see if Pionirski park updates further [F11, F12].

thoughts.sr: Pošto objašnjenje vezano za parking ostaje nerazrešeno, primećujem da Leštane ima maksimume PM10 i PM2.5, dok je maksimum NO2 na Bulevaru despota Stefana. Tokom poslednjeg prelaza između označenih sati, maksimum PM10 porastao je sa 30 na 43 µg/m³, dok je NO2 opao sa 49 na 38 µg/m³, a PM2.5 sa 16 na 15 µg/m³. [F4][F6][F8][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: With the parking explanation still unresolved, I notice that Leštane holds the PM10 and PM2.5 maxima, while the NO2 maximum sits at Bulevar despota Stefana [F4][F6][F8]. Across the latest labelled-hour transition, the PM10 maximum rose from 30 to 43 µg/m³, while NO2 fell from 49 to 38 µg/m³ and PM2.5 from 16 to 15 µg/m³ [F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: Leštane may be a particulate-focused spatial node in this snapshot, distinct from the location of the NO2 maximum [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Will Leštane retain both particulate maxima at the next SEPA reception [F2][F4][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Leštane bi u ovom preseku moglo biti prostorno žarište čestica, odvojeno od lokacije maksimuma NO2 [F4][F6][F8].
questions_sr: Da li će Leštane zadržati oba maksimuma čestica pri sledećem prijemu SEPA podataka [F2][F4][F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-level PM10, PM2.5 and NO2 positions at the next SEPA reception [F2][F4][F6][F8].
